```yaml
name: Claude Code Review
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  claude-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '6.0.x'

      - name: Run Claude Code Review
        uses: sourcegraph/cody-action@v1
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          claude-api-key: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_API_KEY }}
          disable-github-reporter: ${{ env.TUNIT_DISABLE_GITHUB_REPORTER || env.DISABLE_GITHUB_REPORTER }}
        env:
          TUNIT_DISABLE_GITHUB_REPORTER: ${{ vars.TUNIT_DISABLE_GITHUB_REPORTER }}
          DISABLE_GITHUB_REPORTER: ${{ vars.DISABLE_GITHUB_REPORTER }}
```
